# ColumnTrack

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:column-track` · Kerf UI · component · Structure

A horizontal track of equal, min-width columns that scrolls sideways, or pages one column at a time with peek and snapping.

## When to use

Lay out a board of columns (kanban) as one horizontal scroll owner: equal columns that never shrink below a minimum, or a paged phone layout with a peeking next column and start snapping, without app track CSS.

- A board shows several parallel columns (kanban lanes) that must keep a readable width and scroll sideways, or page one at a time on a phone.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for a responsive grid that wraps; use Grid.
- Do not use for two resizable panes; use SplitView or ResizableRegion.
- Do not re-track a Grid from application CSS to get overflowing columns.

**Alternatives:**

- [Grid](./grid.md) (nearest) — Use Grid when columns should wrap or collapse instead of scrolling.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/column-track` — exports `ColumnTrack`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/column-track` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/column-track.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

## Props

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/column-track`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuicolumn-track) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

**Variants (configure, do not restyle):**

- scroll with a minimum column width
- paged with peek and mandatory snapping

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** the columns and their content; choosing scroll or paged layout (for example by device class); drag and drop between columns.

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: none · padding: self (layout role: structure). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- The track pads 8px inline and fills its parent's height; columns sit flush and own their insets and vertical scrolling.

## Accessibility

- Name the track with aria-label through rootAttributes when it is a landmark-like region; give each column a region name. Paged scrolling is smooth unless reduced motion is preferred.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-column-track`, `kui-column-track__columns`.

Never put `kui-column-track`, `kui-column-track__columns` on an element you write; render `ColumnTrack` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-layout-inline-margin`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
